answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7753 Country: India Title: Pls tel me thees all following name is permissible or not and give me its meanings. (1) Shamsu (2) Farzana (3) Tabssum (4) Ashfaque. Question: Assalamo-alaikum Pls tel me thees all following name is permissible or not and give me its meanings. (1) Shamsu (2) Farzana (3) Tabssum (4) Ashfaque. Answer ID: 7753 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1771/1482=B/1429) Shamsu is not an Islamic name. Farzana is a right name, it means: wise. Tabassum is also correct which means: smile, while Ashfaque is also correct, it means: kind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
